Elizabeth as "a pretty present for my Victor"
"Destiny was too potent, and her immutable laws had decreed my utter and terrible destruction"
Chance as "the Angel of Destruction" that leads Victor to Krempe

knownSources.intro: Mary Shelley, Introduction to the 1831 edition (in inputs/pg42324.txt): the revisions "are principally those of style. I have changed no portion of the story, nor introduced any new ideas or circumstances."
